work.englishTitle: Anessa & Hurricane Kimchi's 10th Anniversary Photobook & Poster
work.summary: Physical commemorative photobook-and-poster project featuring drag performers Anessa and Hurricane Kimchi. The successful official campaign describes production of the book and poster and says the photos and illustrations were prepared. Heezy Yang's official bio identifies them as a Seoul-born Korean artist and activist who performs, makes music, and creates original music videos as Hurricane Kimchi. This is creator-led; the source does not describe either performer as a social-media influencer. Campaign dates are not publication dates. ISBN, page count, publisher imprint, and actual shipment date are not stated. No campaign image is stored because exact-asset reuse permission is unconfirmed.
